bearingSource: OSM way 32631748: axis through the middle of the straight west front and the tip of the altar apse ≈ 92.2° (+X towards the apse, east); the minimum-rectangle bearing of 66.4° is an artefact of the trefoil outline. +Z = 182.2° = the south side with the polygonal porch, photographed in 01–02; photos 03–04 show the altar end from the east.
approximations: The OSM outline (≈ 37 × 28 m including the deep eaves) is hand-drawn and asymmetric, while the doors and windows in the photographs indicate a smaller church; the symmetrised outline was therefore scaled to 87 % (walls 30.2 × 22.4 m, 32.6 × 24.8 m over the eaves). Lateral apses (straight stub + half octagon), altar apse (half octagon) and porch shapes are simplified; wall height (5.6 m), roof pitches (40° upper slopes, 20° bell-cast eave skirt on brackets) and tower heights (crosses ≈ 17.5–19.5 m) estimated from the photo ratios. The north side is not photographed and is mirrored from the south without the porch; the west door is assumed. The diamond sheathing of the drums and the carved brackets are simplified. The photographs (July 2011) show the earlier orange-painted sheet roof; all roof surfaces, eave skirts, tower domes and the lantern roof are shown in weathered copper because COLOR METAL supplied copper in 2021–2022 according to its records — which surfaces were re-covered is not documented.

note.ro: Machetă interpretată după fotografii publice de referință din 2011 și după conturul OSM: biserică de lemn în plan treflat, cu pereți placați cu scânduri verticale, streașină largă pe console, pridvor poligonal pe latura de sud și trei turle octogonale cu coifuri bombate. Fotografiile sunt anterioare lucrărilor, de aceea acoperișurile și coifurile sunt redate în cuprul livrat de COLOR METAL conform evidențelor sale. Dimensiunile au fost corectate după fotografii, înălțimile sunt estimate, iar latura de nord este presupusă.
note.hu: Nyilvános, 2011-es referenciafotók és az OSM-körvonal alapján értelmezett makett: háromkaréjos alaprajzú fatemplom függőleges deszkaburkolattal, konzolokon nyugvó széles ereszekkel, a déli oldalon sokszögű előcsarnokkal és három nyolcszögű, domború sisakú toronnyal. A fényképek a munkák előtt készültek, ezért a tetőket és a sisakokat a COLOR METAL nyilvántartása szerint szállított rézzel ábrázoljuk. A méreteket a fotók alapján korrigáltuk, a magasságok becsültek, az északi oldal feltételezett.
note.en: Scale model interpreted from public reference photographs (2011) and the OSM outline: a trefoil-plan wooden church clad in vertical boards, with deep bracketed eaves, a polygonal porch on the south side and three octagonal drum towers with bulging caps. The photographs predate the works, so the roofs and caps are shown in the copper supplied by COLOR METAL according to its records. Dimensions were corrected from the photographs, heights are estimated and the north side is assumed.
